date_note: The page gives only its publication day (25 November); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
title: Deichmann says hackers accessed customer data in its online shop; Snipes also affected
summary: Unknown hackers accessed customer data in Deichmann's online shop, per Der Spiegel (via UA.NEWS) and dpa. Deichmann says names, addresses, invoices, email addresses, phone numbers and the chosen payment method may be affected, but not passwords, account access or card numbers. It says it closed the vulnerability, filed a criminal complaint and has no signs of misuse. APA says Austrian customers were informed; dpa says Snipes is also affected.
plain: Deichmann says hackers accessed some customer data in its online shop. It says names, contact details, invoices and the chosen payment method may be affected, but not passwords or card numbers.
exec: Deichmann reports unauthorised access to customer data in its online shop; it says it closed the vulnerability and has no signs of misuse.
action: As Deichmann advises, check the sender of unexpected messages and compare payment demands with your invoices; the company says its bank details have not changed and it never asks for passwords or payment data by email, phone or SMS.

validation.note: UA.NEWS (relaying Der Spiegel) and Marktspiegel/vol.at (dpa, APA) each state Deichmann's statement; Deichmann's own notice was not read.

review.note: attribution: Austria is from APA (vol.at), Snipes from dpa; summary said dpa for both
